title: Continuous Profile Optimizer + Batch Guard
creator: Priya Natarajan
description:
Problem: teams run with static batching settings that degrade cost or latency as traffic shapes change. We need a continuous, low-risk system that recommends batching and cache parameters per workload and can apply them safely with automatic rollback if regressions are detected.

This ticket scopes the first iteration: a service ('profile-optimizer') that synthesizes workload profiles from request telemetry, derives heuristic parameter candidates (batch_size_target, max_latency_budget_ms, kv_cache_prefix_ttl, coalescing_window_ms), validates candidates in a safety sandbox, and exposes a staged apply path (recommend -> canary -> apply) with rollback triggers based on production SLIs/QLIs.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Component ingests 7 days of request traces and generates a per-route profile summary.
2) Heuristic engine outputs 1-3 ranked parameter sets with estimated cost delta and latency risk.
3) Safe-apply flow supports canary (1% traffic) and automated rollback if latency P95 or error rate regressions exceed configured thresholds.
4) Integrations: Console shows recommendations and per-apply audit logs; runtime accepts and enforces new config; can revert within 15 minutes automatically.
5) E2E tests validate no more than 5% increase in tail latency in the worst-case simulated workloads during a canary run.
success_metrics:
- Average token cost savings across pilot routes >= 8% within 30 days.
- No more than 2 auto-rollbacks per month in pilot.
- Ratio of accepted recommendations / produced recommendations >= 0.35 after 8 weeks.
- Observability: recommendation precision (predicted latency delta vs actual) R^2 >= 0.6.
approach:
Phase A (this ticket):
- Data ingestion: lightweight profiler agent aggregates per-request metadata (route, model, seq_len, prefix_hash, response_tokens, latency_ms, success_flag) using existing runtime hooks.
- Profile synthesis: compute spectral histograms of sequence lengths and inter-arrival distribution; generate a compact fingerprint for workload clustering.
- Heuristics: rule-based candidate generation derived from cost/latency trade-off model (cost ~= tokens / batch_efficiency; latency approximated using queueing + model p99). Include conservative defaults and aggressive candidates.
- Sandbox validation: replay synthetic traffic with candidate configs on a small dedicated cluster (isolated) to estimate actual token throughput and tail latency.
- Safety checks: require that any candidate with predicted P95 worse than baseline by >10% be marked manual review.
- Exposure: write recommendations to Console API and create a PR-like "apply plan" with metadata.

Engineering notes: prefer evented streaming of traces to avoid large batch ETL; keep profile snapshots small (~10KB per route). Use the existing profiler proto to remain compatible with telemetry pipelines.
heuristics_detail:
Key heuristic signals used to rank candidates:
- Mean and 95th percentile sequence length (to select batch size that maximizes utilization without inflating KV cache miss penalties).
- Inter-arrival time PDF mode and tail (to tune coalescing_window_ms).
- Prefix reuse ratio (to decide whether to enable more aggressive KV prefix TTLs).
- Sensitivity score computed via small-sample A/B replay (estimates latency delta).
Ranking function: score = alpha*cost_reduction_est + beta*(1 - latency_risk_est) + gamma*stability_bonus, with tunable weights. We will ship with conservative alpha=0.6, beta=0.3, gamma=0.1 and allow PM/SE to tune via Console.
rollout_plan:
1) Internal QA: unit + integration + sandbox validation (1 week).
2) Canary: pick 5 low-risk routes across 3 customers; apply at 1% traffic for 6 hours with elevated telemetry sampling.
3) Monitor: automated gates (latency P95, error rate, token cost behavior) for 30m windows; if gates pass, increase to 10% for 12 hours.
4) Full apply: schedule maintenance window for 24h ramp to 100% with health checks.
5) Post-apply: run monthly re-profiling and surface updated recommendations.
Notes: All applies create an immutable audit entry and a rollback plan that includes timestamp, owner, and reason.
rollback_plan:
Automatic rollback triggers: any of the following within the canary window or first 2 hours after full apply:
- P95 latency increase > 12% absolute vs baseline and sustained for >= 3 consecutive 5m buckets.
- Error rate increase > 0.5 percentage points absolute and sustained for >= 3 consecutive 5m buckets.
- Throughput drop impacting availability (internal circuit-breaker).
If triggered: system reverts batching config to the last-known-good in the runtime config store, notifies owners via PagerDuty + Console, and opens an incident playbook link. Manual rollback: owners can revert from Console with 1-click; the system records reason and diagnostics snapshot.
test_plan:
- Unit tests: heuristics math, fingerprinting determinism, API schema.
- Integration: end-to-end recommendation generation from 7-day synthetic trace and replay in sandbox cluster.
- Load test: synthetic GA traffic shapes to validate no regression beyond acceptance thresholds.
- Chaos: simulate delayed telemetry and partial dataplane partitions and verify safe-apply doesn't proceed without quorum.
- Regression: run candidate apply in staging and assert rollback triggers under injected latency/error anomalies.
